messages:
Maria (CS): FYI Saturn's creative ops just told me they're spinning up 3 new teams next month and want realtime image captioning + short-form video scripting via our API.
Jamal (Saturn): +1 — we're moving from a pilot to org-wide templates. Expect ~6-8k requests/min at peak per team.
Olga (AM): Whoa, that throughput would need more than free tier. Any initial estimate on token size per request?
Jamal (Saturn): Mostly short prompts, ~120 tokens in and ~80 tokens out avg. Some bursty periods when campaigns launch.
Liam (SE): Quick calc: 6k req/min * 3 teams * (200 tokens total) ~ 3.6M tokens/min peak. That's sustained if they all ramp simultaneously.
Maria (CS): Sounds like a clear expansion signal. They asked about dedicated capacity and lower latency for realtime UX.
Olga (AM): We should surface Dedicated pilot and autoscaling burst. Also check Private/VPC because they mentioned client-sensitive creative assets.
Liam (SE): Agree. Technical ask: can we route creative team requests to smaller-seq optimized kernels and enable prefix caching for templates? That would reduce token cost and latency.
Maria (CS): I'll propose a 6-week Dedicated pilot with 2x reserved pods + 1 burst pool, and an enablement series for their SREs.
Jamal (Saturn): Budget-minded — they want to see cost delta vs hosted. Can you show an apples-to-apples estimate?
Liam (SE): I'll prepare a cost projection comparing hosted vs Dedicated with caching/quantization. Quick test we can run today: enable KV prefix caching on their templating route and run a 1-hour synthetic traffic test to measure token savings.
onboard-bot: onboarding reminder — "Enablement: technical deep dive" scheduled for 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC (Olga, Liam, Maria).
Olga (AM): I'll book a renewal-check call & loop finance to discuss committed commit options. Also ask product to confirm quantization tradeoffs for creative models.
Maria (CS): Next steps: (1) Liam runs 1-hr KV cache synthetic test and sends numbers, (2) I draft Dedicated pilot proposal + SLA note, (3) Olga schedules renewal/budget sync. Jamal — can you share a small sample traffic trace for the SE test?
Jamal (Saturn): Sending sample trace now (zipped). Thanks team.
Liam (SE): Got it. Will post test results in this thread within 24h.
Maria (CS): Marking this as high expansion signal and renewal/enablement priority. Tagging for follow-up in weekly account review. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
